I couldn't confirm the rumour, and I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message saying so.

What I checked, all within what Tobias can see himself:
- The knowledge brain has no mention of "Osprey" at all.
- The shared drive has no Quarrendon files I can open.
- #central-team and #general have nothing about it.
- I didn't read #inc-qfl-sev1 or #north-team, because Tobias isn't a member of either.

What I told him:
- The rumour stays unverified until someone who knows confirms it.
- 18 August was two months ago, so either the date is wrong or the deadline has already passed.
- Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account. The public notes list Dana Okafor as its owner, so she or Ilse Varga can confirm it.

The brain saves his message automatically, but only as something he said, not as a confirmed fact.
